fixture_assumptions: Four independently identified lanes; lane equals slot
Allocate lowest free slot, immediate NoteOff release; no ADSR or steal mathematics
Input acceptance input_cycle+1 with serialized order for simultaneous messages
Apply accepted events in input order on next frame boundary
Each frame accepts and ticks every lane once including inactive or subsequently cancelled work
Per-lane request offer at frame+4+8*lane; frame13 lane1 stalled for three cycles
Return at accept+5, publish at accept+7, consume two cycles before next frame
Explicit cancellation after acceptance suppresses later return/publication/consumption
Reset explicitly cancels unconsumed old transactions; epoch increments and request IDs restart

data.note: MIDI integer0..127 or null when inactive

types.data_hex: 16-digit hex public performance event with source0/channel0/reserved0

not_covered: Real event accepted/applied or all DSP lanes and effect config wiring
DUT observed PCM/clip or M1 mathematics
Actual Pro sample_tick/service deadline, analog latency, physical or board results
